title: West of Fifth
summary: "West of Fifth" by Catharine Brody is a novel written in the early 20th century. It follows Grace Kline, a striking and ambitious young woman navigating New York’s newsrooms, garment-district offices, and Broadway nightclubs as she claws into publicity work while sustaining a fraught affair with a married man. Around her spin the hard-driving press agent Harry Strauss, his streetwise lieutenant Al Epstein, the guarded secretary Anita Vestry, and Grace’s loyal friend Letty, sketching a world where hustle, class, and desire collide.
